description: This file defines service functions related to user profile operations, including retrieving a user profile, following a user, and unfollowing a user. It interacts with a Prisma ORM client for database operations and utilizes utility functions for mapping profiles.

methods.name: getProfile
methods.description: Retrieves a user profile by username, with optional user ID, including followers information, and maps the database profile to application output.

methods.name: followUser
methods.description: Allows a user to follow another user identified by username, updating the follower relationship in the database, and returns the mapped profile.

methods.name: unfollowUser
methods.description: Allows a user to unfollow another user identified by username, updating the follower relationship, and returns the mapped profile.

ctags.name: followUser
ctags.pattern: /^export const followUser = async (usernamePayload: string, id: number) => {$/

ctags.name: getProfile
ctags.pattern: /^export const getProfile = async (usernamePayload: string, id?: number) => {$/

ctags.name: unfollowUser
ctags.pattern: /^export const unfollowUser = async (usernamePayload: string, id: number) => {$/
